# TaskStart

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Starts a task created by CreateTask().

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0C` SVC_MANAGETASK | `MNGTASK_START (0)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err TaskStart(Handle h, void *entry, void *sp, uint32_t r0, uint32_t r1);
```

**Registers:** `(task, &args) -> r0 status`

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | Task handle with PERM_CNTL. |
| `entry` | in | Address the task starts executing at. |
| `sp` | in | Its initial stack pointer. |
| `r0` | in | Value of r0 at entry. |
| `r1` | in | Value of r1 at entry. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `h` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `h` is not a task. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `h` lacks PERM_CNTL. |
| [`ERR_BUSY`](../errors.md#err_busy) | The task has already been started. |
